title: Henry's law constants (Sander, version 5.0.0) as tidy tables
description:
A machine-readable edition (CSV, Parquet, SQLite) of Rolf Sander's compilation of Henry's law constants for water as solvent, version 5.0.0: the 46,434 values for 10,173 species and the 1,076 entries of its literature table (the paper counts 995 references), converted from the SQL file published at henrys-law.org, with an errata layer, checks, and tools for checking new releases.

All credit for the data belongs to Rolf Sander. Please cite his paper: R. Sander, Compilation of Henry's law constants (version 5.0.0) for water as solvent, Atmos. Chem. Phys. 23, 10901-12440, 2023, doi:10.5194/acp-23-10901-2023. This edition is not an official release.
